qs.q: What blood component is prepared by thawing fresh frozen plasma (FFP) at 4 degrees Celsius and is specifically indicated for fibrinogen deficiency, von Willebrand disease, or factor VIII deficiency?
qs.e: Cryoprecipitate is collected when FFP is thawed at 4 degrees, refrozen, and stored up to 1 year; it is used in fibrinogen deficiency, von Willebrand disease, and factor VIII, XIII, or DIC states.
